verdict.line: You lose if you all-in the instant his W (Path Maker) is up or eat a free Q stack-two pull; you win if you bait that dash out, bank your W (Indestructible) shield, then isolate him with R (Realm of Death) once he's already spent E (Footwork) or All Out.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's W (Indestructible) converts damage dealt and taken into a shield he can consume to heal, which lets him win any trade that goes past the first exchange — and K'Sante has no way to burst through that in a single combo. Morde's R (Realm of Death) is the actual counter to K'Sante's kit: it drags him into a 1v1 pocket where his team can't peel, heal, or body-block for him. The lane hinges on whether K'Sante lands his W (Path Maker) charge-stun or Q (Ntofo Strikes) stack-two pull before Morde can out-sustain and isolate him.

theirWindow.what: That fires a shockwave that pulls you in. Back off before he lands the second stack, or accept the pull and immediately answer with your own E (Death's Grasp) rather than trying to walk away.

yourWindow.when: His W (Path Maker) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no stun/knockback for 14 down to 10 seconds depending on rank. Step in with E (Death's Grasp) to pull him into full combo range and commit to the trade.

start.why: Negates his short-line Q pokes and autos so you take free lane damage.

boots.why: Cuts the physical damage from his autos and Q strikes.

core.why: Percent-health burn cuts through his high base health and tank build.
Adds tankiness for extended trades and shreds his magic resist while your W stacks up.
The slow keeps him inside your E (Death's Grasp) range and Q follow-ups.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the extended trades your W (Indestructible) is built to win and adds health you'll need before his all-in windows.

summoners.why: Teleport resets you to lane or lets you skip base after a roam without losing wave or turret pressure; Flash covers landing E (Death's Grasp) or dodging his W (Path Maker) dash.

playing.title: Bait the W dash
playing.detail: Stand at your max E range and let him commit his W (Path Maker) charge before you engage. Once it's spent he has no stun or knockback for 14 down to 10 seconds.

playing.title: Respect stack two on Q
playing.detail: Back off before his Q (Ntofo Strikes) hits 2 stacks, or hold your E (Death's Grasp) ready to punish the moment he over-extends into the pull.

playing.title: Bank the shield before committing
playing.detail: Only go all-in once your W (Indestructible) shield is charged. Consuming it to heal mid-trade is what lets you outlast his short bursts.

playing.title: Ult after his All Out
playing.detail: If he burns R (All Out) to engage, follow with your own R (Realm of Death). His reduced defenses from All Out mean he takes far more damage isolated with you than in a straight fight.

playing.title: Punish after Footwork
playing.detail: His E (Footwork) is his only out-of-combat shield or dash, on an 8 to 10 second cooldown. Trade hard in the window right after he uses it.

playing.title: Don't feed the chain CC
playing.detail: Once his Q is ranked past 1, avoid standing in his line so a stack-two pull can't chain into his W stun for a full combo you can't escape.

playing.title: Isolate before objectives
playing.detail: Use R (Realm of Death) just before drake or herald fights to pull him out of position so he can't peel for or engage your teammates.
